会。登录 iCloud 并开启同步后，数据会通过你的 iCloud 私有库在 iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch 之间自动同步。

安全。应用无账号、无服务器、无广告与追踪，数据仅在你的设备与个人 iCloud 中，开发者无法访问。详见本站隐私政策。

# Memoria 隐私政策

生效日期：2026 年 8 月 7 日

Memoria（以下简称“本应用”）是一款用于记录生日、纪念日与重要日子的工具。我们高度重视你的隐私。本应用不设账号、不设服务器，也不会收集或上传你的任何个人信息到我们这里。

## 一、我们收集哪些信息
我们不收集任何个人信息。你在本应用中创建的内容（如姓名、日期、备注、颜色等）仅保存在你的设备本地。

## 二、iCloud 同步
如果你登录了 iCloud 并开启同步，你的数据会通过 Apple 的 CloudKit 私有数据库在你自己的 iPhone、iPad、Apple Watch 之间同步。这些数据存储在你个人的 iCloud 账户中，受 Apple 的隐私政策保护，开发者无法访问、读取或获取这些内容。

## 三、Face ID / 面容与密码
如果你启用了应用锁，本应用会调用系统的本地身份验证（Face ID / Touch ID / 设备密码）来解锁。相关生物识别数据由系统在设备本地处理，本应用不会接触、存储或传输任何生物识别信息。

## 四、通知提醒
本应用使用本地通知在你设定的时间提醒纪念日，通知内容仅在你的设备上生成，不经过任何服务器。

## 五、第三方与追踪
本应用不包含任何广告、第三方分析、埋点或追踪 SDK，不会将数据分享给任何第三方。

## 六、数据的保存与删除
你的数据完全由你掌控。你可以随时在应用内编辑或删除记录；删除 iCloud 中的数据可在系统「设置 → iCloud」中管理。卸载应用即删除本地数据。

## 七、儿童隐私
本应用不面向 13 周岁以下儿童定向收集信息；由于我们本就不收集任何个人数据，因此适用于所有年龄的使用者。

## 八、政策变更
若本政策有更新，我们会在本页面发布最新版本并更新生效日期。

## 九、联系我们
如对隐私有任何疑问，请联系：neverfall@foxmail.com

### Will my data sync to other devices?
Yes. Once you sign in to iCloud and enable sync, your data automatically syncs across iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch through your private iCloud library.

# Memoria Privacy Policy

Effective date: August 7, 2026

Memoria (hereinafter the "App") is a tool for recording birthdays, anniversaries, and important days. We take your privacy very seriously. The App has no accounts and no servers, and it does not collect or upload any of your personal information to us.

## 1. What Information We Collect
We do not collect any personal information. The content you create in the App (such as names, dates, notes, and colors) is stored only locally on your device.

## 2. iCloud Sync
If you are signed in to iCloud and have enabled sync, your data is synced across your own iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch through Apple's CloudKit private database. This data is stored in your personal iCloud account, protected by Apple's privacy policy, and the developer cannot access, read, or obtain any of it.

## 3. Face ID and Passcode
If you enable the app lock, the App uses the system's local authentication (Face ID / Touch ID / device passcode) to unlock. The related biometric data is processed locally on your device by the system; the App never accesses, stores, or transmits any biometric information.

## 4. Notifications and Reminders
The App uses local notifications to remind you of anniversaries at the times you set. Notification content is generated only on your device and does not pass through any server.

## 5. Third Parties and Tracking
The App contains no advertising, third-party analytics, event tracking, or tracking SDKs, and does not share data with any third party.

## 6. Data Retention and Deletion
Your data is entirely under your control. You can edit or delete records within the App at any time; to delete data in iCloud, manage it under "Settings → iCloud" on your device. Uninstalling the App deletes the local data.

## 7. Children's Privacy
The App does not target children under the age of 13 for information collection; because we do not collect any personal data at all, it is suitable for users of all ages.

## 8. Changes to This Policy
If this policy is updated, we will publish the latest version on this page and update the effective date.

## 9. Contact Us
If you have any questions about privacy, please contact: neverfall@foxmail.com

# 时光轨迹 技术支持

遇到问题或有想法？先看看下面的常见问题，或直接联系我们——通常 1–2 个工作日内回复。

## 联系方式
最快的方式是发邮件，附上问题描述与设备信息。

- 支持邮箱：neverfall@foxmail.com
- App Store：可前往下载 / 评价
- 测试版:可加入 TestFlight 参与体验

## 常见问题

### 时光轨迹会一直定位我吗？
记录由你掌控，可随时暂停。App 使用系统定位在后台记录轨迹；数据默认只保存在本机，除非你主动开启 iCloud 备份。

### 需要哪些权限？
后台记录需要「定位（始终 + 精确）」；「运动与健身」用于更准确的步数与活动识别；「通知」用于提醒（可选）；仅当你导入照片时才需要「照片」权限。除定位外均为可选。

### 定位没有被记录？
- 设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 定位服务 → 时光轨迹 → 选择「始终」，并开启「精确位置」。
- 为 App 开启「后台 App 刷新」。
- 「低电量模式」可能暂停后台定位，建议关闭后重试。
- 重启 iPhone，再打开一次时光轨迹。

### 感觉比较耗电？
- App 已使用智能采样；在信号良好、移动较少时功耗更低。
- 保持系统与 App 为最新版本。
- 长时间静止时会自动降低采样频率。

### iCloud 备份如何工作？换机怎么恢复？
开启后，轨迹会按天增量备份到你自己的 iCloud 私有空间（CloudKit）。换机或重装后本地为空时，App 会提示「从 iCloud 恢复」；也可在「iCloud 数据备份 → 数据同步」里手动「立即同步」，或用右上角「全量同步」确保云端与本机一致。前提：各设备登录同一 Apple ID、已开启 iCloud、网络正常，并在同步时保持 App 在前台。

### 「删除」一个轨迹点会怎样？
删除是「隐藏」而非物理抹除：被删的点不再显示、不计入统计与迷雾，并且这个隐藏状态会随 iCloud 同步到你的其它设备，删了不会再「复活」。

### 如何彻底清除数据？
可在 App 设置中清除本机数据。如已开启 iCloud 备份，请一并在「iCloud 数据备份」中删除云端备份；在其它登录同一 Apple ID 的设备上也需相应清理。

## 反馈问题
发邮件给我们，附上问题描述与设备信息会更有助于定位。反馈邮箱：neverfall@foxmail.com。隐私相关内容见本站隐私政策。

# 时光轨迹 TimeTrails 隐私政策

最后更新：2026 年 8 月 9 日 · 适用于 iOS 应用「时光轨迹 TimeTrails」

你的轨迹，只属于你。

## 概述
时光轨迹是一款隐私优先的轨迹记录应用。我们的核心原则很简单：你的数据默认只保存在你自己的设备上。App 不需要注册账号，不接入广告，不使用第三方分析或追踪 SDK，也不会把你的数据出售或共享给任何第三方。

## 我们收集哪些信息
为实现轨迹记录与回顾，App 会在你授权后于本机收集与生成以下数据：

- 位置信息：为在后台持续记录轨迹，需要“精确位置”和“始终”定位权限。位置数据用于绘制轨迹、点亮迷雾、统计里程等。
- 运动与健身数据：如步数与活动类型，用于更准确地区分步行/骑行/驾车等，并完善每日统计。
- 时间与时区：每个轨迹点记录采样时的时间与时区，用于按“当地时间”正确地分天与汇总。
- 派生数据：由上述原始数据在本机计算得到的常去地点、停留时段、每日汇总、迷雾探索范围，以及你主动添加的轨迹备注等。
- 照片（可选）：仅当你主动导入照片以关联轨迹时，才会访问相册。

App 不收集你的姓名、手机号、通讯录等身份信息，也不要求你创建账号。

## 数据存储在哪里
默认情况下，以上所有数据仅存储在你的设备本地（本机数据库），不会上传到我们的服务器——事实上，本 App 没有用于存放你个人数据的服务器。

## iCloud 备份与同步（可选，默认关闭）
你可以选择开启“iCloud 数据备份”。开启后：

- 数据仅备份到你自己的 iCloud 私有数据库（Apple CloudKit Private Database），归属于你的 Apple ID。
- 只有你本人（登录同一 Apple ID 的设备）可以访问这些数据；我们无法访问，数据也不经过我们的任何服务器。
- 其作用是让你在换机或重装后恢复数据，或在你自己的多台设备间同步。
- 你可以随时关闭该功能，或在 App 内删除云端备份。iCloud 的使用同时受 Apple 隐私政策约束。

## 地名解析（反向地理编码）
为把坐标显示为可读的地点名称，App 可能将相关坐标发送给 Apple 的地图/地理编码服务以获取地名。该过程由系统能力提供，受 Apple 隐私政策约束；我们不会因此保存或转发你的坐标到第三方。

## 网络请求
App 可能发起少量与个人数据无关的网络请求，例如检查新版本。这些请求不包含你的轨迹或身份信息。

## 我们不会做的事
- 不投放广告、不接入广告 SDK。
- 不使用第三方分析或用户行为追踪。
- 不构建用户画像。
- 不出售、不出租、不共享你的个人数据。

## 权限说明
- 定位：后台记录轨迹的核心权限（建议“始终 + 精确”）。
- 运动与健身：用于步数统计与活动识别。
- 通知：用于提醒等（可选）。
- 照片：仅在你导入照片时使用（可选）。

除定位外，其余权限均为可选；你可随时在系统“设置”中调整或撤销任意权限。

## 你的控制权
- 随时暂停或恢复轨迹记录。
- “删除”某个轨迹点为隐藏处理：该点不再显示、不计入统计与迷雾，并会随 iCloud 同步到你的其它设备。
- 可在 App 内清除本机数据；如开启了 iCloud 备份，可一并删除云端备份。

# TimeTrails Support

Running into a problem or have an idea? Take a look at the FAQ below, or contact us directly — we usually reply within 1–2 business days.

## How to Reach Us
The fastest way is by email, with a description of the issue and your device information.

- Support email: neverfall@foxmail.com
- App Store: Download / leave a review
- Beta: Join our TestFlight to try it out

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does TimeTrails track my location all the time?
Recording is in your hands and can be paused anytime. The app uses the system's location services to record trails in the background; by default, data is saved only on your device unless you actively enable iCloud Backup.

### What permissions are needed?
Background recording requires "Location (Always + Precise)"; "Motion & Fitness" is used for more accurate step counts and activity recognition; "Notifications" is used for reminders (optional); and "Photos" is only needed when you import photos. Everything except location is optional.

### My location isn't being recorded?
- Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → TimeTrails → select "Always," and turn on "Precise Location."
- Enable "Background App Refresh" for the app.
- "Low Power Mode" may pause background location; try turning it off and retrying.
- Restart your iPhone, then open TimeTrails again.

### It seems to drain the battery?
- The app already uses smart sampling; power usage is lower when the signal is good and you're moving less.
- Keep your system and the app up to date.
- When you stay still for a long time, the sampling frequency is automatically reduced.

### How does iCloud Backup work? How do I restore after switching devices?
Once enabled, your trails are backed up incrementally by day to your own iCloud private space (CloudKit). After switching or reinstalling on a device, when local data is empty, the app will prompt you to "Restore from iCloud"; you can also manually "Sync Now" under "iCloud Data Backup → Data Sync," or use "Full Sync" in the top-right corner to ensure the cloud and your device are consistent. Prerequisites: all devices are signed in to the same Apple ID, iCloud is enabled, the network is working, and the app is kept in the foreground during syncing.

### What happens when I "delete" a trail point?
Deleting is a "hide" rather than a physical erase: the deleted point is no longer displayed, is excluded from statistics and the fog map, and this hidden state syncs to your other devices via iCloud, so it won't "come back" after being deleted.

### How do I completely clear my data?
You can clear on-device data in the app's settings. If iCloud Backup is enabled, please also delete the cloud backup under "iCloud Data Backup"; you'll need to clean up accordingly on other devices signed in to the same Apple ID as well.

## Reporting Issues
Email us — including a description of the issue and your device information helps us pinpoint it. Feedback email: neverfall@foxmail.com. For privacy-related matters, see the Privacy Policy on this site.

# TimeTrails Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 9, 2026 · Applies to the iOS app "TimeTrails"

Your trails belong to you alone.

## Overview
TimeTrails is a privacy-first trail recording app. Our core principle is simple: by default, your data stays only on your own device. The app requires no account, includes no ads, uses no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs, and will never sell or share your data with any third party.

## What Information We Collect
To record and review your trails, the app collects and generates the following data on your device after you grant permission:

- Location data: To continuously record your trails in the background, the app needs "precise location" and "always" location permissions. Location data is used to draw trails, reveal the fog map, calculate distance, and more.
- Motion and fitness data: Such as step count and activity type, used to more accurately distinguish walking, cycling, driving, and so on, and to refine your daily statistics.
- Time and time zone: Each trail point records the time and time zone at the moment of sampling, so days can be split and summarized correctly by "local time."
- Derived data: Frequently visited places, dwell periods, daily summaries, fog exploration areas, and any trail notes you add yourself, all computed on your device from the raw data above.
- Photos (optional): The photo library is accessed only when you actively import photos to associate with a trail.

The app does not collect identifying information such as your name, phone number, or contacts, and it does not require you to create an account.

## Where Your Data Is Stored
By default, all of the data above is stored only locally on your device (in an on-device database) and is not uploaded to our servers. In fact, this app has no server for storing your personal data.

## iCloud Backup and Sync (Optional, Off by Default)
You can choose to enable "iCloud Data Backup." Once enabled:

- Your data is backed up only to your own iCloud private database (Apple CloudKit Private Database), tied to your Apple ID.
- Only you (devices signed in to the same Apple ID) can access this data; we cannot access it, and the data never passes through any of our servers.
- Its purpose is to let you restore your data after switching or reinstalling on a device, or to sync across your own multiple devices.
- You can turn this feature off at any time, or delete the cloud backup within the app. Use of iCloud is also subject to Apple's Privacy Policy.

## Place Name Resolution (Reverse Geocoding)
To display coordinates as readable place names, the app may send the relevant coordinates to Apple's map/geocoding services to obtain place names. This process is provided by the system and is subject to Apple's Privacy Policy; we do not thereby store or forward your coordinates to any third party.

## Network Requests
The app may make a small number of network requests unrelated to your personal data, such as checking for new versions. These requests do not contain your trails or identifying information.

## What We Will Not Do
- No advertising and no ad SDKs.
- No third-party analytics or user behavior tracking.
- No building of user profiles.
- No selling, renting, or sharing of your personal data.

## Permissions Explained
- Location: The core permission for recording trails in the background ("Always + Precise" recommended).
- Motion and Fitness: Used for step counting and activity recognition.
- Notifications: Used for reminders and the like (optional).
- Photos: Used only when you import photos (optional).

Apart from location, all other permissions are optional; you can adjust or revoke any permission at any time in the system Settings.

## Your Controls
- Pause or resume trail recording at any time.
- "Deleting" a trail point is a hide action: the point is no longer displayed, is excluded from statistics and the fog map, and this state syncs to your other devices via iCloud.
- You can clear on-device data within the app; if iCloud Backup is enabled, you can delete the cloud backup as well.
- You can revoke any permission in the system Settings.

## Data Retention and Deletion
Your data remains on your device (and in the iCloud private space you choose to enable) until you delete it or uninstall the app. Uninstalling the app removes the on-device data; if you previously enabled iCloud Backup, the cloud copy must be deleted separately by you, either within the app or through iCloud.

## Children's Privacy
This app is not designed for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

## Changes to This Policy
If this policy is materially updated, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page and, where appropriate, notify you within the app.

## Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at neverfall@foxmail.com.

en.tagline: Record, analyze, and replay your trips locally on your device — your data never leaves for a server.
en.description: TraceApp is a privacy-focused iOS trip-tracking app. Built on CoreLocation and CoreMotion, it records your routes, distance, and pace directly on your device, with support for track replay and visualization. By default, all data stays only in your device's local sandbox. There are no built-in third-party ad or analytics SDKs, and you can revoke permissions or delete your data at any time.

# TraceApp Support

Welcome to TraceApp. If you run into problems or have suggestions, feel free to reach out to us through the channels below.

## Contact & Technical Support
- Support email: flywithbug@163.com
- WeChat business support: online on weekdays 10:00–19:00; you can add us via the support QR code in the app.

## Submitting Feedback
When submitting feedback, we recommend providing as much of the following as possible so we can locate and resolve the issue faster:

- Title: A brief description of your issue or suggestion.
- Type: Bug/error, feature request, interaction/experience, or other.
- Detailed description: Steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual result; screenshots welcome.
- Experience rating: 1–5 stars.
- Optional contact info: Email or QQ, so we can reply to you.
- System information: Device model, OS version, etc., to help us troubleshoot.

## Join Our Community
- QQ Group 1: 574966492
- QQ Group 2: 185198503 (full)
- WeChat business support: online on weekdays 10:00–19:00; scan or long-press to recognize the QR code to add us.

## FAQ

### How do I add WeChat support?
Under "Join Our Community," long-press the WeChat business support QR code to recognize and add it. Support is online on weekdays 10:00–19:00.

### Can't join QQ Group 2?
QQ Group 2 is full. Please join QQ Group 1 (574966492).

### What information should I include when giving feedback?
We recommend providing a title, issue type, detailed description (including steps to reproduce), experience rating, and optional contact info, and you may include system information to help with troubleshooting.

# TraceApp Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2025-10-12

This Privacy Policy applies to the mobile application services provided by TraceApp (hereinafter referred to as "this App"). We take the protection of your personal information and privacy seriously, and we aim to explain clearly and readably: what information we collect; how we use, store, and protect this information; and what rights you have and how to exercise them.

When you download, install, or use this App, you are deemed to have read and agreed to the terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please stop using and uninstall this App.

## 1. Information We Collect and Use
To deliver its core functions (recording and displaying your trips), this App processes only the following types of information locally on your device:

- Location data (required): Used to record and display your routes, distance, speed, and more. Sourced from iOS CoreLocation and collected only after you grant location permission.
- Motion / activity data such as walking and running (optional): Used to calculate step count, activity type, and more. Sourced from CoreMotion (where applicable).
- Network connection status (for prompts only): Used to determine whether online maps or syncing are available. Does not include any content data.

We do not collect: account information, contacts, SMS/call records, photo library content, microphone/camera data, advertising identifiers (IDFA), or any tracking identifiers that could be used to serve ads. We also do not embed any third-party analytics or advertising SDKs.

## 2. Storage and Transmission of Information
- Local storage: Your tracks and related statistics are stored by default in your device's local app sandbox.
- iCloud (if you enable it): Once you turn on iCloud sync, the relevant data may sync across your devices via iCloud. iCloud is provided and protected by Apple; we do not have access to your iCloud credentials or content.
- No upload to our own servers: Unless a cloud service is added in a future version and explicitly authorized by you, this App does not upload your data to the developer's own servers.

## 3. How We Use Information
- To provide features such as trip tracking, distance/pace statistics, track replay, and visualization;
- To provide you with basic network status prompts and error diagnostics (no content is uploaded).

## 4. Permissions and How to Revoke Them (iOS)
- Location Services: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → TraceApp, where you can choose "While Using the App" or "Always," and turn it off at any time.
- Motion & Fitness: Settings → Privacy & Security → Motion & Fitness → TraceApp, where you can revoke the permission at any time.
- Cellular/Wi-Fi: Settings → TraceApp, where you can turn off "Wireless Data (Wi-Fi & Cellular)."

After you turn off the relevant permissions, some features may become unavailable, but this does not affect your continued use of other features that do not depend on those permissions.

## 5. Your Rights
- Access and export: You can view your track history within the App; to export it, you can use the system share feature (if available) to export images/files.
- Correction: You can delete incorrect records and record again; we do not process or alter your data.
- Deletion: You can delete individual records or all records within the App; uninstalling the App will delete local data. If you use iCloud, synced data must be managed and deleted separately in your iCloud settings.
- Withdrawing consent: Turn off the relevant permissions in iOS Settings, or stop using / uninstall this App.

## 6. Data Security
- Local data is protected by the iOS sandbox mechanism;
- The security of iCloud transmission/storage is provided by Apple (see Apple's privacy documentation for details).

## 7. Children's Privacy
This App is intended for the general public and does not provide services to minors aged 14 or under. If you believe we have collected a minor's information without guardian consent, please contact flywithbug@gmail.com so we can address it.

## 8. Third Parties and Sharing
- The current version does not integrate any third-party advertising/statistics/analytics SDKs, and does not share your personal information with any third party.
- If third-party services are added in the future, we will update this policy, provide a prominent notice within the App, and obtain your explicit consent before enabling them.

## 9. Changes to This Policy
We may revise this policy in response to changes in features or regulations. If a change may materially affect your rights, we will provide a prominent notice within the App or notify you by other reasonable means. The revised version takes effect upon publication; if you do not agree, you may stop using and uninstall the App.

## 10. Contact Us
If you have any questions, suggestions, or complaints about this policy or privacy protection, please contact us via:

- Email: flywithbug@gmail.com
